prompt: A coding assistant loads the entire 4,000-file repository into the prompt before each task.
why: Give it search and read tools and let it pull files as needed.
trap: Compaction cleans up after; this avoids loading in the first place.

prompt: A text-to-SQL bot gets all 600 table schemas in every prompt, and quality drops.
tells: all 600 table schemas in every prompt
why: Provide a table list and a tool to fetch only the schemas needed.

prompt: Instead of pasting log files, the agent gets their paths and a grep tool.
tells: gets their paths and a grep tool
why: Lightweight references let the agent load just the lines it needs.
trap: It's the core idea of agentic search.

prompt: An assistant's system prompt includes all 40 API reference pages, though each question needs one or two.
why: Fetch the relevant pages per question.
trap: Caching makes the big prompt cheaper but not more focused.
